It is also described as a writing system for the synthesis of topic outlines through retrieval and multi-perspective question asking.

STORM is proposed as a paradigm for synthesizing information and is based on Large Language Model (LLM) technology. It is designed to assist in the writing process by creating outlines, researching topics, and generating articles.

In summary, STORM is a proposed writing system that utilizes LLM technology to automate the pre-writing stage, research topics, and generate articles, with the goal of synthesizing information and creating high-quality content.
